integration_issues.issue: SemanticIntelligencePanel is NOT mounted on the /workspace (root) page — only on /auto-investigate. Pasting the octal payload on the Workspace tab and clicking its AUTO INVESTIGATE runs the legacy chain analyzer (which returns 'Partial Decode · 25%') and NEVER emits any semantic-v2-* testid. The review request text says 'In the Analyst Workspace, pasting a PowerShell -EncodedCommand payload and clicking AUTO INVESTIGATE triggers the Semantic Intelligence panel to render' — that acceptance criterion only holds when the analyst is on the AUTO INVESTIGATE tab (grep confirms SemanticIntelligencePanel is imported ONLY by AutoInvestigatePage.jsx, not WorkspacePage.jsx). Either (a) mount SemanticIntelligencePanel on WorkspacePage as well, or (b) clarify docs/tests that the new panel lives on /auto-investigate.

action_items: Decide whether SemanticIntelligencePanel should also mount on WorkspacePage — currently it only renders on /auto-investigate. The review request wording implies it should render inside the Analyst Workspace as well.
critical_code_review_comments: SemanticIntelligencePanel.jsx is now 832 lines and hosts 5 sub-components (DecodeFailureCard, DecodeTimeline, ExplainableVerdict, DeobfuscationChain, BehaviorStoryline) plus the panel export. Approaching the 700-line soft cap — split each sub-component into its own file under /components/investigation/semantic/ for maintainability.

The octal-reconstruction deob stage only produced ONE stage even though 'Recursive PowerShell Decode chain' was called out in the P0 requirement. Product-wise this is correct (a single Octal ASCII reconstruction is sufficient to reach the boundary op Invoke-Expression), but the panel header 'Recursive Deobfuscation · 1 deterministic stage' may under-sell the recursion story to SOC analysts on payloads that only need one pass. Consider a subtitle explaining 'recursion halted at fixed point / execution boundary'.

Workspace / AutoInvestigate feature parity: two different investigation UIs live in the same app and the new semantic panel is only wired into one of them — this is a discoverability trap for analysts.
